sentences.en: It was silly of you to make such a mistake.
sentences.zh: 你犯这样的错误真是太蠢了。

sentences.en: He wasn't silly enough to tell that story before her.
sentences.zh: 他可没傻到会在她面前讲那个故事。

sentences.en: Workers put up with silly rules for a long time.
sentences.zh: 工人们忍受愚蠢的规定已经很久了。

senses.zh: 愚蠢的，傻的；嬉笑滑稽的；失去理智的；微不足道的，不实用的；（板球）（防守位置）靠近击球手的
